text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Deputy Minister of Metallurgy Wang Wanbing says China will list more steel firms.
- Investors welcome the move by the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges to order brokerages to announce on their trading floors each day's active stocks and major traders.
- Half a year has passed since the Shanghai stock exchange began issuing a blue-chip index of 30 listed firms which has proved to be an effective market barometer.
- BUSINESS NEWS - A direct daily train linking Shanghai and Hong Kong will come into operation from April 1.
- The East China Fair, a major annual trade exposition for Shanghai and surrouding provinces, will open on Wednesday morning.
- Exports by the Pudong development area accounted for 20 percent of Shanghai's 1996 total.
